title: Prototype Agent Result
description: Structured output from the prototype agent. The post-script reads target_branch and pr_body; prototype fields are for telemetry and traceability.

target_branch.description: Branch the PR should target. Determined from issue context or repo default.

pr_body.description: PR description with prototype summary, journeys, and states. Supports markdown.

closes_issue.description: Whether the PR should close the linked issue. Defaults to false — prototypes are discussion artifacts, not issue resolutions.

inject_issue_scope.description: Whether the post-script should inject the issue number as a conventional-commit scope.

prototype_id.description: Artifact identifier, typically the issue key (e.g., PROJ-298).

prototype_type.description: Whether the prototype is standalone HTML or integrated into a workspace codebase.

journeys_count.description: Number of user journeys enumerated in journeys.json.
